name: wavy-background
title: Wavy Background
description: Layers of soft token-colored waves that drift sideways behind your content, as filled ocean waves, thin silk lines, or stacked bands.

props.name: variant
props.description: ocean: blurred filled waves along the bottom. silk: thin flowing lines through the middle. layered: stacked bands like hills.

props.name: color
props.type: muted | ink | primary | success | warning | danger
props.description: Token color of the waves. Each layer uses its own opacity.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the waves drift. Back layers always move a little slower than front layers.

props.name: waves
props.description: Number of wave layers, from 3 to 5.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the waves.

a11y: The wave layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
With reduced motion, the waves stop and stay in place.

ai.whenToUse: A calm, moving backdrop for a hero, newsletter card, sign-in page, or 404 page.
rules: Add bottom padding with class so text does not sit on the densest waves
Use silk behind forms and dense text, ocean or layered behind short headings
Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component

id.description: Lapisan gelombang lembut berwarna token yang bergeser pelan di belakang konten, berupa ombak terisi, garis sutra tipis, atau pita bertumpuk.

props.variant: ocean: ombak terisi yang diburamkan di bagian bawah. silk: garis tipis mengalir di tengah. layered: pita bertumpuk seperti bukit.
props.color: Warna token gelombang. Setiap lapis memakai opasitasnya sendiri.
props.speed: Kecepatan gelombang bergeser. Lapis belakang selalu sedikit lebih lambat dari lapis depan.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas gelombang.

a11y: Lapisan gelombang memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Dengan reduced motion, gelombang berhenti dan diam di tempat.

ai.whenToUse: Latar bergerak yang tenang untuk hero, kartu newsletter, halaman masuk, atau halaman 404.
rules: Tambahkan padding bawah lewat class supaya teks tidak menumpuk di gelombang paling rapat
Pakai silk di belakang form dan teks padat, ocean atau layered di belakang judul pendek
Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
